pages.title: Neural Synthesizer
pages.text: The $(item)Neural Synthesizer$() grows photonic neural networks and the artificial minds that run on them.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.

Photonic networks compute with light instead of electrons: interference in waveguides performs the matrix multiplications at the heart of a neural network, fast and with little heat. I have stopped asking what the minds think of me.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Computronium Ingot, Error-Correction Lattice, General AI Core, Narrow AI Core, Neural Lattice, Photonic Neuron, Superintelligence Core.
